component.name: jellytoast
component.summary: Audio-first music client for Jellyfin and Subsonic

description.p: jellytoast is a native PySide6 desktop music client for Jellyfin and Subsonic / OpenSubsonic / Navidrome servers. Bit-perfect mpv playback, gapless audio, MPRIS2 system integration, system-tray controls, and a floating mini player.

ul.li: Browse albums, artists, songs, playlists, genres, and internet radio
Native search across both providers with offline-aware filtering
Bit-perfect mpv playback with optional server-side transcode tiers and ReplayGain (track / album)
Casting: Chromecast, AirPlay 2, DLNA, Sonos, and Snapcast — each toggleable per-protocol
Local cast relay for remote / Tailscale / self-signed servers (devices that can't reach the source)
Explicit downloads with full offline playback (cascade by album / artist / playlist) and offline indicator
Synced and plain lyrics, with a dedicated now-playing page
Floating mini player with optional always-on-top on KDE Wayland
ListenBrainz and Last.fm scrobbling with offline queue
Smart shuffle, smart playlists, sleep timer with fade-to-stop, tag editing (Jellyfin)

description.p: Initial pre-release. Casting (Chromecast, AirPlay 2, DLNA, Sonos, Snapcast control surface), explicit downloads with offline playback, MPRIS2 + system tray, floating mini player, ListenBrainz / Last.fm scrobbling, smart shuffle, smart playlists, sleep timer with fade-to-stop, tag editing (Jellyfin), per-protocol cast toggles + discovery timing.
